workflow_steps.description: Receive shared items from iOS Share Sheet (Reels link, YouTube Shorts, video file, audio, or text)

workflow_steps.logic: IF Shortcut Input has URLs OR text contains 'http': type = 'url', url = extracted_url. ELSE IF Shortcut Input is Media/File: type = 'upload', file = Shortcut Input.

workflow_steps.payload: IF type == 'url': JSON {'source_type': 'url', 'url': url}. IF type == 'upload': Upload to {backend_url}/v1/media/upload then POST {'source_type': 'upload', 'upload_file_path': upload_file_path}

workflow_steps.description: Repeat up to 25 times with 2-second delay: GET {backend_url}/v1/jobs/{job_id}. If status == 'completed' or 'failed', exit repeat.

workflow_steps.logic:
Text banner: 'ReelTranscribe ✓ Transcription complete
Language: {final_result.language.primary}
Transcript:
{final_result.transcription.final}'

IF final_result.captions.detected == true: Append '

Captions: ✓ Original captions detected.
Files available: SRT, VTT'. Provide Menu: [Copy Transcript, Share Transcript, Save SRT, Save VTT]. ELSE: Append '

✓ Transcript ready. No original captions detected. Subtitle files were not generated.' Provide Menu: [Copy Transcript, Share Transcript].
